newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices fall sharply on little demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices fall sharply on little demand.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell sharply on Thursday on virtually-nil consumer demand at the end of the Hindu Diwali festival season, dealers said.
They said increased offerings by mill owners triggered higher arrivals in the market.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 24/25 rupees to 1,265/1,301 while M-30 eased by 14/20 rupees to 1,300/1,351. Sugar mill delivery fell to 1,190/1,200 from 1,195/1,210 rupees.
Overall market sentiment was subdued at the close.
